items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Al Gafa with me today

ctx.x: Good for you. All right, thanks a lot for your time. I’ll pause and we’ll say our good- byes.
Great. Thank you, Monk. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
